title: Future: will & going to · 将来时：will 与 be going to
pattern: Subject + will + V  Subject + am / is / are + going to + V
summary: will 多用于当场决定、承诺和个人看法；going to 多用于已有计划和根据眼前迹象的预测。
explanation: 英语谈论将来有好几种说法，中文里常常都说成“要”或“会”，所以学习者容易混淆。**will** 常用于说话的那一刻做出的决定、承诺，或基于个人看法的预测；**be going to** 常用于事先已经计划好的事，或根据眼前迹象做出的预测。
**will 的结构**是 subject + will + 动词原形，不加 to，也不随人称变化：I **will call** you tomorrow. 否定是 will not，缩写为 won't：She **won't be** late. 缩写形式 I'll、you'll、we'll 在口语和书面中都很常见。
**going to 的结构**是 am / is / are + going to + 动词原形：We **are going to move** to Shanghai next year. 这里的 be 动词要和主语一致。注意 going to 中的 to 后面是动词原形，不能加 -s 或 -ing。
**预测的区别**：如果你看到了眼前的迹象，就用 going to：Look at those clouds. It's **going to rain**. 如果只是个人想法或主观判断，用 will：I think you **will enjoy** the trip. 中文“我觉得它会……”有时可以对应 will，但要看是否有明显的迹象。
在时间和条件从句（when、if、before、after、as soon as 等引导的从句）中，即使表示将来，也要用一般现在时而不是 will：**When** she **arrives**, we will start the meeting. 这是很多中国学生容易忽略的地方，需要特别记住。
mistakes: ✗ I will to go home tomorrow. → ✓ I will go home tomorrow. will 后面直接接动词原形，不加 to。
✗ When he will come, we will eat. → ✓ When he comes, we will eat. 时间从句中表示将来也要用一般现在时。
✗ It's going to rains tomorrow. → ✓ It's going to rain tomorrow. going to 后面用动词原形，不加 -s。
✗ I will meeting her tomorrow. → ✓ I will meet her tomorrow. will 后面是动词原形 meet，不能用 -ing 形式。

examples.text: I'll help you with your homework.
examples.note: 说话时当场做出的承诺，用 will。

examples.text: The phone is ringing. I'll answer it.
examples.note: 当场决定，用 'll（will 的缩写）。

examples.text: We are going to move to Shanghai next year.
examples.translation: 我们明年打算搬到上海。
examples.note: 事先已有的计划，用 going to。

examples.text: Look at those black clouds. It's going to rain.
examples.translation: 你看那些乌云，要下雨了。
examples.note: 根据眼前的迹象做预测。

examples.text: I think you will enjoy the trip.
examples.translation: 我觉得你会喜欢这次旅行。

examples.text: When she arrives, we will start the meeting.
examples.translation: 等她到了，我们就开始开会。
examples.note: 时间从句用一般现在时表示将来。

exercises.sentence: Look at the sky! It ___ rain soon.
exercises.translation: 你看天空！很快要下雨了。
exercises.explanation: 根据眼前的迹象做预测，用 is going to rain。

exercises.sentence: Don't worry, I ___ help you tomorrow.
exercises.translation: 别担心，我明天会帮你的。
exercises.explanation: 承诺用 will + 动词原形 help。

exercises.translation: 小心！那个杯子要掉下来了！
exercises.explanation: 眼前的迹象表明即将发生，用 is going to fall。

exercises.sentence: Hold on, I ___ get the door.
exercises.explanation: 当场做出的决定用 will + 动词原形 get。

exercises.source: 我们打算明年学习法语。
options: We will going to learn French next year.
We are going to learn French next year.
We going to learn French next year.
We will learning French next year.
exercises.explanation: 已有的计划用 are going to learn。

exercises.source: 我会在你到家之后给你打电话。
options: I will call you after you will get home.
I call you after you get home.
I will call you after you get home.
I will calling you after you get home.
exercises.explanation: after 引导的时间从句用一般现在时 get 表示将来，主句用 will call。

options: We're going to buy a new car.
When he will arrive, we'll eat.
exercises.explanation: 时间从句中不用 will，应写成 When he arrives, we'll eat.

options: She will be a doctor one day.
exercises.explanation: going to 后面用动词原形，应写成 It's going to snow later.

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 周日我打算去看望奶奶。
exercises.explanation: 已有的计划用 be going to + 动词原形。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.explanation: 当场做出的决定和承诺用 will。
